services.name: Cheer Stars
services.desc: Whether you’re stepping onto the mat for the first time or aiming to take your skills to the next level, High Point Gymnastics Academy offers the perfect cheer program for you. Proudly based in High Point and serving families in Winston-Salem, Greensboro, and Jamestown, NC, our expert coaches, supportive environment, and fun-filled classes are designed to help every athlete grow in confidence, strength, and spirit. From foundational skills to advanced stunts, we’re here to help you shine - and have a blast along the way. Spaces fill fast - sign up today and let’s make this your most exciting year yet! services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Get ready for a summer full of gymnastics, games, new friends, and unforgettable memories at High Point Gymnastics Academy’s Summer Camps! Our camps are designed for kids who love to move, learn new skills, and have tons of fun. Hosted by our expert coaches in a safe, supportive environment, camp is a great way to stay active and engaged throughout the summer. Located in High Point, we work with families across the Triad, including Winston-Salem, Greensboro, and Jamestown. At HPGA, we proudly offer exhilarating summer camps that are specifically centered around enjoyable gymnastics training, designed to spark a passion for movement and fitness in every participant. services.name: Exhibition Week
services.desc: It’s time to celebrate an incredible year of progress, confidence, and fun! Our Annual Exhibition is a beloved High Point Gymnastics Academy tradition and a highlight of the season where students get to show off the skills they’ve worked so hard to master. This event is an optional but highly anticipated celebration for our entire gymnastics community - perfect for family, friends, and teammates to come together and cheer on every child! Over the course of the week, gymnasts from all classes will have their turn to take the floor, perform fun routines, and showcase the progress they’ve made this year.
